title: The report's filters clear, count and explain what they show
description: Diagnosed live (headless Chromium over v3.8.0, de21866c and ab2e9547, acme-store and the dogfood plan; identical on all three, no console error). Root causes: (1) plugins/audit/scripts/ui/report/date-range.js clearAll() resets q, phaseStatus, modelFilter, dates, preset, taskStatus, auFilter, areaFilter but never tevFilter/tevFlag nor their bars, while filters.js refresh() counts both in narrows/anyFilter/fcount and syncHash writes them to the hash and to localStorage audit-view-<title>; exports.js restores them on reopen. Introduced by d073dbcf; third instance of one class (auFilter and areaFilter were each forgotten before; tests/test_render_report.py c3 and d1 pin one field each). Every axis is listed by hand in about seven places across four parts. (2) filters.js showP = matchAll && inView(seg): on a plan with most phases archived the default Active & pending view turns date range, 7/30-day presets, test gate and observed into 0 phases with 'No phase matches these filters' (_report_page.py:758) although e.g. 309 tasks in 25 phases match under View=All; areas.js syncAreaOptions removes header Area options the view cannot show, leaving a select with only 'All areas'; #audit-count says '165 phases' while 5 show and counts cancelled tasks in its denominator while the header excludes them. (3) phone 390x844: sticky header+nav+toolbar cover 465px; More filters panel clipped. (4) Global filters mix scopes invisibly (Author scopes Usage only, Area the table only, dates both). Owner decision for (2): only when nothing is drawn AND matches exist outside the view, the empty state names the count and offers Show all phases (e.g. 'No phase in Active & pending matches - 25 archived phases do · Show all phases'); when results show there is no standing row (the earlier owner decision against a standing 'matches outside this view' notice stands); the counter states its basis ('5 of 165 phases (Active & pending)') and task denominators use the header's basis. Probes from the diagnosis: <outside-repo> and extras.mjs (renders under ../out/<sha>/{acme,dogfood}/).
desiredOutcome: Clear filters lifts every filter axis, in the page, the hash and storage, and a new axis is cleared, encoded, restored and counted without being listed by hand; when the view hides matches the empty state says how many and offers Show all phases; the counter names its basis; on a 390px phone the filters do not cover the table and More filters is not clipped; every header control names its scope; and the browser gate proves Clear and the empty state on a fixture whose default view hides matches

The executor's claim admits only that ph2 extends the existing check ('ph2 sits inside the existing phone More-filters branch, right after the sticky-share check it extends. ph1 measures the resting stack...').

If ph1 has to run for a report with no More-filters panel, move the shared measurement out of the `if` and keep the open-state assertion inside it, so there are still not two methods. findings.issue: This is an inherited case in the task's gate. 'sticky: the stack is restated at runtime' checks only `"measureStack" in M._SCRIPT and "--topbar-h" in M._SCRIPT and "ResizeObserver" in M._SCRIPT`. measureStack() could be emptied to a no-op and the case would still pass, because all three substrings stay in the script through the declaration, the listeners and other code. findings.resolution: Either retire the case in favour of st2 plus the browser gate's stack checks, or make it assert the setProperty calls for each of --topbar-h, --strip-h and the sectools height, so emptying the function turns it red.

findings.issue: The shut bound is strip + shut bar + slack, read from the same layout it judges, so it grows with the bar. No check now caps how much of the phone the resting filters cover. The removed ph1 block capped the stack at 50% of PHONE_TALL. Now a shut .sectools of any height passes the absolute arm. The relative arm only catches that for the committed documents it has a row for. For a report outside the checkout or an untracked scratch render, judge() returns early with the note 'the relative arm did not run for it (the absolute bar above did)'. For those reports nothing asserts the phase outcome 'on a 390px phone the filters do not cover the table'. A shut bar covering 80% of the screen goes green. On the same shutStack result, add a ceiling: a share of PHONE_TALL with its basis stated in the comment, e.g. the table keeps at least half of the screen it is read on. That keeps one method and still bounds the destination. If no such ceiling is wanted, judge()'s unrecorded-document notes must stop telling the reader that an absolute bar covered the document. They should say instead that the shut bar's height went unbounded on this run.

findings.issue: The diff makes this file's prose about the absolute arm false. The header says the gate 'bounds the share of a phone screen an OPEN filter panel may pin'. It says the absolute arm 'saturates — the gate scrolls a fixed distance past the bar'. It says 'the absolute arm catches the DESTINATION', and that 'The shut figure has NO absolute bar'. After this diff the absolute arm is a hit-test of what pins over the table, both shut and open, against layer-derived bounds. It no longer scrolls a fixed distance, and the shut state does have a bound. The executor reports this in its outcome, refused by the plan gate (the file is declared by P125.56-0h5), so it is disclosed, not hidden. It is still a stale claim the diff created, and it crosses the gate/relative-arm boundary this file exists to describe.
findings.resolution: Rewrite the header and the two '(the absolute bar above did)' notes in a task that owns tools/ui-checks/layout-baseline.mjs (P163.7-d6t is pending on the same file), stating the new absolute arm: one hit-test, shut and open, each bounded by the layers allowed to pin.

findings.issue: st5's label says measureStack() runs 'on every observed layer', but nothing in the assertion sees the observe loop (page-state.js:143-145, `for (const el of [toolbar, snav, document.querySelector('.sectools')]) { if (el) ro.observe(el); }`). Deleting that loop, or dropping one element from its array, leaves `new ResizeObserver(measureStack)` present once and st5 green, so the observer is constructed but never fires. This goes beyond the task's clause, which asked only for the setProperty calls, so it is filed low. It is the same label-claims-more-than-it-sees shape that R5 retired.
findings.resolution: Either assert that the observe loop names toolbar, snav and .sectools and calls ro.observe(el), for example by pinning the loop's text exactly once, or narrow the label to 'handed to a ResizeObserver' so it claims only what is asserted.

DEFECT: filters.js refresh() applies the View to every match (showP = matchAll && inView(seg)), and when nothing is drawn the empty state (_report_page.py around line 758) says 'No phase matches these filters.' - false on any plan with most phases archived: on the dogfood plan From 2026-10-23 shows 0 phases while 25 archived phases (309 tasks) match; acme-store's Test gate 'Before recording' shows 0 while archived P0 holds both matching tasks. #audit-count says '165 phases' while 5 show, and its task denominator counts cancelled tasks while the header excludes them. areas.js syncAreaOptions removes header Area options the view cannot show, leaving a select whose only option is 'All areas' (a control every use of which is a no-op).

OWNER DECISION (binding):
1. Only when nothing is drawn AND phases outside the current View match, the empty state names the count and the view, and offers a button that switches the View to all phases: e.g. 'No phase in Active & pending matches - 25 archived phases do · Show all phases'. refresh() already computes matchAll before the view is applied: count matches outside the view from that, do not re-filter. The new button reuses the View control's own path (set it and dispatch its change), so the stored view and hash stay consistent.
